title: A zone's street crowd: res/field/castelia_rush/<zone>.json
description: The passers-by and speech balloons of a zone whose scripts run CasteliaRushInit (script command 0x134), from archive a/1/8/3: the first 0x32 bytes of CasteliaRushConfig in src/ov121/castelia_rush.c, which CasteliaRushConfig_Load reads. Named after the zone's ZONE_ constant, lowercased without the prefix. order.json lists the zones in the archive's order. tools/data/castelia_rush_data.py packs them. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

intervals.description: By day period (DAY_PERIOD_ of src/system/rtc.h): the frames between a lane's passers-by, and the modulus of the frames between balloons (a balloon comes every rand % interval + 16 frames). Must not be 0

unk_a.description: CasteliaRushConfig.unkA, which no code reads; 0 in every zone

lane_count.description: How many of the lanes passers-by walk

obj_codes.description: The passers-by's object codes, each picked at random; only the first obj_code_count are used, and the rest are leftovers (255)

obj_code_count.description: How many of obj_codes are used (a modulus)

msg_base.description: The first message of the balloons, in res/text/script/global_10350.txt (SCRIPT_TEXT_GLOBAL_10350)

msg_count.description: How many messages from msg_base the balloons pick from; msg_base + msg_count is at most 256. Paper White 2's build skips the empty ones

step_frames.description: The frames a passer-by takes for a step, which picks its walking animation (CasteliaRushConfig_GetWalkAcmd)

unk19.description: CasteliaRushConfig.unk19, which no code reads; 0 in every zone

lanes.description: The lanes, of which the first lane_count are walked

lane.description: A lane (CasteliaRushLane), in tiles: passers-by start on its edge at x_min (dir left or right) or z_min (dir up or down), at a random place across it, and walk in dir for steps; stepping aside keeps them within the bounds
